description: Moved the jug and told them to leave the lease where it was.
name: Cuthbert Burbage

description: Said twenty-one years, and two to run, and stopped there.
name: James Burbage

description: Gave the eleven pound eight, said Item, and paid the slice.
name: John Heminges

description: Took the bean gravely, issued the three decrees, and fined Heminges a slice for Sam.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Hailed the king and kept his mother out of the speeches.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Present. Silent. Took the last slice and the fine.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Lasted half the prayer, stood on the Greenwich paper, and did not mind the Admiral's men.
name: Will Kemp

description: Said the yard had been full, and that nobody minds Greenwich, and left the money on the sharers' side.
name: William Shakespeare
